identity.title: Serious Paper Trading System + Paper Cockpit
identity.objective: Implement a deterministic persistent simulated-paper trading system bound to eligible WP172 executable-edge evidence, with spot-token accounting, hard pre-order paper risk, append-only SQLite reconciliation and restart recovery, deterministic replay, read-only WP169 live-store tailing, and a GET-only extension of the existing local operator cockpit, without credentials, real execution, or live authority.
identity.xl_authorization_basis: The user explicitly authorized the attached WP173 XL RUNTIME package as one coherent paper OMS, accounting, risk, reconciliation, runtime, and read-only cockpit vertical slice with a hard maximum of 35 changed files.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert WP173. The dedicated paper SQLite store, simulated OMS, accounting, risk, foreground replay/live-store adapters, focused tests, cockpit paper projection, and package/status documentation are removed. WP169, WP170, and WP172 canonical evidence remains unmodified; no credentials, real orders, live mode, workflow, dependency, or external product-network capability exists.

api_matrix.reason: WP173 adds one bounded simulated-paper runtime API and six GET-only cockpit projections while preserving predecessor APIs.
